source: {i}Yeah… That’s right… {/i}
translation: {i}对……就是这样……{/i}

source: {i}A-Ahh… Y-Yeah…{/i}
{i}That’s right… Go slow… I like it that way…{/i}
translation: {i}对……慢一点……我喜欢这样……{/i}

source: G-Gah…!
It was just a dream…
translation: 原来只是一场梦……

source: Now I’m turned on too… Good thing nobody is around right now to see this…
translation: 现在我也兴奋起来了……幸好此刻周围没人看到……

source: *sigh* This must be because of what happened last night… It made me so pent up…
translation: *叹气* 一定是昨晚发生的事害的……把我憋得太厉害了……

source: I couldn’t even sleep properly thanks to that… Holding it in wasn’t a good idea, after all.
translation: 拜它所赐，我连觉都没睡好……看来强忍着终究不是个好主意。

source: I guess it can’t be helped… I haven’t had time for anything like that in a long time…
translation: 看来也没办法……我已经很久没有时间做这种事了……

source: I guess I can handle it alone this time…
translation: 这次我想自己解决就好……

source: Now that I think about it… I wonder if that was a subtle invite…
translation: 现在想想……不知道那是不是一种含蓄的邀请……

source: {i}After relieving myself, I hurriedly cleaned up my mess and got ready for the day…{/i}
translation: {i}发泄过后，我匆忙收拾干净，开始为今天做准备……{/i}

source: {i}Since everyone else was gone from the cabin again this morning, they must’ve already gotten to work… I’d have to catch up.{/i}
translation: {i}今天早上大家又已经离开了小屋，肯定都开始工作了……我得赶上他们。{/i}

source: {i}(Oh, we have a visitor! And she looks so… well-dressed.){/i}
translation: {i}（哦，我们有访客！而且她看起来……衣着非常讲究。）{/i}

source: Ahhh~ There he is! The man of the hour~ I was waiting for you, Yoshinori!
translation: 啊～他来了！今天的主角～我一直在等你，Yoshinori！

source: Since when were you the tardy person, hmm? Have all these years at Camp Buddy really changed you that much?
translation: 你什么时候变成会迟到的人了，嗯？在伙伴营的这些年真让你改变了这么多？

source: Wait, don’t tell me you don’t remember me?!
translation: 等等，别告诉我你不记得我了？！

source: And here I was, hoping that you’d be the one to introduce me to everyone because you knew me the best!
translation: 我还指望由最了解我的你把我介绍给大家呢！

source: W-Wait a minute. Emilia?! I-Is that you?
translation: 等、等一下。Emilia？！真、真的是你吗？

source: Bingo~! You got that right! I’ll give you a pass for that lapse in memory, since this place is so far away from civilization~
translation: 答对了～！没错就是我！看在这里远离文明社会的份上，你一时没认出我就算了～

source: I… can’t believe it. It’s been so long, I barely recognized you!
translation: 真……不敢相信。已经过去这么久，我差点没认出你！

source: I could say the same for you! And… well, everyone for that matter.
translation: 我也可以这么说你！而且……其实这里每个人都是。

source: What brings you back here to Camp Buddy? This is the last place I’d expect to see you…
translation: 是什么让你回到伙伴营？这里可是我最想不到会见到你的地方……

source: Why that’s not a very hospitable way to welcome back an alumnus. Let’s just say I’m here on very important business.
translation: 这样欢迎老营员可一点都不好客。你只要知道，我是为一项非常重要的公务而来。

source: Ms. Komarova here was chosen to be the inspector for the whole project by Clermont Inc.
translation: 这位Komarova女士被Clermont公司选为整个项目的检查员。

source: Whoa, really?!
translation: 哇，真的吗？！

source: You seem surprised~! I hope that’s a good thing!
translation: 你好像很惊讶～！希望这是件好事！

source: Oh, it’s just… It’s so unexpected! I didn’t know you worked for Mr. Clermont, especially for a job like this…
translation: 哦，只是……太出乎意料了！我不知道你为Clermont先生工作，更没想到会做这种职务……

source: I can’t blame you for holding me to such a high standard even after all these years – I come from an unforgettably prestigious background after all~
translation: 这么多年过去，你仍然对我抱有那么高的期待，我也不能怪你——毕竟我的出身尊贵得令人难忘～

source: But after seeing the opportunity, I just knew that I was the perfect fit!
translation: 不过看到这个机会后，我立刻知道自己是最合适的人选！

source: And there’s no better time than the present, so let’s get started!
translation: 择日不如撞日，我们开始吧！

source: Before anything else, I believe we should at least introduce you to the team.
translation: 在做其他事之前，我认为至少应该先把你介绍给团队。

source: The only people I need to know are already familiar faces, so there’s no need for that.
translation: 我需要认识的人本来就都是老面孔，所以没那个必要。

source: And for those new ones, you’ll know me when you know me.
translation: 至于那些新人，该认识我的时候自然会认识。

source: Now, shall we proceed with the preliminary inspection?
translation: 现在，可以开始初步检查了吗？

source: Wait… I thought the inspection was scheduled for the end of the week though?
translation: 等等……我还以为检查安排在本周末？

source: I told Mr. Clermont I would be arriving ahead of schedule. The best inspections are done unexpectedly, after all.
translation: 我告诉Clermont先生自己会提前到达。毕竟最有效的检查都该出其不意。

source: I see…
translation: 我明白了……

source: After all, you’ve hooked a pretty big fish – having Clermont Inc. sponsor this camp.
translation: 毕竟你们钓到了一条大鱼——让Clermont公司赞助这座营地。

source: Thankfully, for all of you, I’m here to make sure he gets his money’s worth~
translation: 你们都该庆幸有我来确保他的钱花得物有所值～

source: Pssst… Can you guys fill me in on who she is? Seems like she knows the rest of you.
translation: 嘘……你们能告诉我她是谁吗？看来她认识你们其他人。

source: And she looks like she isn’t a fan of introductions either…
translation: 而且她看起来也不喜欢自我介绍……

source: Oh… She’s that rich girl from back then. Can’t forget about her.
translation: 哦……她就是当年那个富家女。想忘都忘不掉。

source: I did.
translation: 我忘了。

source: I’m not sure I remember right, but… I think she used to hang out with Yoshi a lot…
translation: 不知道我有没有记错，不过……她以前好像经常和Yoshi待在一起……

source: Whoa! Yoshinori? Really?
translation: 哇！Yoshinori？真的吗？

source: Ehh… I think the more accurate term was ‘clingy’. Yoshi’s super nice to everyone, after all.
translation: 呃……我觉得更准确的说法是“黏人”。毕竟Yoshi对每个人都特别友善。

source: You mean, Yoshi’s the only one who tolerated her. Ugh… Why does she have to be the inspector, of all people?
translation: 你是说，Yoshi是唯一受得了她的人。呃……为什么偏偏要由她来当检查员？

source: Sounds like everyone isn’t a fan of her…
translation: 听起来大家都不太喜欢她……

source: It can’t be helped. She made quite the impression from the very start.
translation: 这也没办法。她从一开始就给人留下了极其深刻的印象。

source: Oh yeah… It was on a camping trip, if I remember right…
translation: 哦，对了……如果没记错，那是在一次露营旅行中……

source: Alright, we’ve arrived at our destination!
translation: 好了，我们到达目的地了！

source: For this camping trip, I want you all to work together in groups of six to set up camp!
translation: 这次露营，我要你们六人一组合作搭建营地！

source: I’ve assigned different tasks for each group, and everyone needs to finish before sunset!
translation: 我为每组分配了不同任务，所有人都必须在日落前完成！

source: Your scoutmasters will be watching, and if we see any of you slacking off, you’ll get a demerit badge!
translation: 教官们会监督你们，如果发现有人偷懒，就会得到一枚记过徽章！

source: Oh, Sir Goro! I can be in charge of the tents!
translation: 哦，Goro先生！我可以负责帐篷！

source: Hahaha! Getting dibs on the most difficult one, I see.
translation: 哈哈哈！看来你抢先选了最难的任务。

source: That’s not a problem, Sir Goro! I already have Yuri and Aiden with me anyway! We just need to get three more people!
translation: 没问题，Goro先生！反正Yuri和Aiden已经和我一组了！只要再找三个人！

source: *pats head* Alright! I’ll leave that up to you, and I’ll check on your group myself before sunset!
translation: *摸头* 好！那就交给你了，日落前我会亲自检查你们这组！

source: Yes, sir! Thank you, sir!
translation: 是，先生！谢谢您，先生！

source: I’ll attend to the other groups! Get to work!
translation: 我去照看其他小组！开始工作吧！

source: Yoshi, why did you have to choose the most boring chore…? We could’ve gone exploring and finding stuff like firewood or something!
translation: Yoshi，你为什么非要选最无聊的杂务……？我们本来可以去探索，找柴火之类的东西！

source: We already did that last camping trip! We don’t want to do the same thing over and over, right?
translation: 上次露营我们已经做过了！总不能一遍又一遍做同样的事，对吧？

source: Besides, it’ll show the scoutmasters how flexible we are, no matter the task!
translation: 而且这能向教官们证明，无论什么任务我们都能灵活应对！

source: You’re such a dork, Yoshi.
translation: 你真是个傻瓜，Yoshi。

source: I think it’ll be fun! It’s my first time actually joining you guys camping, after all!
translation: 我觉得会很有趣！毕竟这是我第一次真正和你们一起露营！

source: See? Aiden gets it! Where’s your camping spirit, Yuri?
translation: 看吧？Aiden懂我！你的露营精神去哪了，Yuri？

source: *sigh* Fine, you guys win.
translation: *叹气* 好吧，你们赢了。

source: Where are we gonna get three more people though? We definitely need the help, ’cause I'm not good at building like Yoshi.
translation: 不过我们去哪里再找三个人？肯定需要帮手，因为我不像Yoshi那样擅长搭建。

source: Did somebody say BUILDING?!
translation: 有人说搭建吗？！

source: Look no more, the Dar-Lloyd Builder Duo is here to save the day!
translation: 不用再找了，Dar—Lloyd建筑双人组前来救场！

source: Oh, it’s Little Lloyd and Serious Darius!
translation: 哦，是小个子Lloyd和严肃的Darius！

source: HEY! Do you want our help or not?!
translation: 喂！你们到底要不要帮忙？！

source: Cool! With Darius on our team, this will be a piece of cake!
translation: 太好了！有Darius加入，这会轻而易举！

source: Hello?! I’m here!
translation: 喂？！我也在这里！

source: Great, that’s two more! Welcome to the group!
translation: 很好，又有两个人！欢迎加入小组！

source: Just one left, then!
translation: 那么只差一个了！

source: Yeah… Hmm, let’s see…
translation: 是啊……嗯，让我看看……

source: Everyone else seems to have their own groups already…
translation: 其他人好像都已经有自己的小组了……

source: Oh, wait, how about her? She looks like she’s just standing there alone. Why don’t we invite her?
translation: 哦，等等，她怎么样？看起来只有她一个人站在那里。为什么不邀请她？

source: The new girl?
translation: 那个新来的女孩？

source: I don’t know… I’ve heard a lot of things about her… So, I just try and stay away.
translation: 我不知道……听说过很多关于她的事……所以我尽量离她远点。

source: What? Really?
translation: 什么？真的吗？

source: Oh yeah, I heard she made quite the scene when she was enrolled here a few days ago…
translation: 哦，对了，我听说她几天前入营时大闹了一场……

source: Dad said she’s from a very wealthy family… I don’t think she’s used to a more “rustic” lifestyle…
translation: 爸爸说她来自非常富裕的家庭……我觉得她不习惯这种更“乡野”的生活方式……

source: Rumor is that she screamed, scratched and cursed at the scoutmasters ’cause she didn’t want to be here.
translation: 传言说她不想待在这里，所以对教官们又叫又抓，还破口大骂。

source: Yikes, sounds like a red flag.
translation: 天啊，听起来很危险。

source: Stranger danger.
translation: 陌生人危险。

source: I didn’t hear anything like that from Dad though… Is that really true?
translation: 可我没从爸爸那里听说这种事……是真的吗？

source: Yeah! Maybe some people just made that up! I really don’t like it when others gossip like that!
translation: 是啊！也许只是有人编出来的！我真的很讨厌别人这样说闲话！

source: Besides, we haven’t even met her yet! We can’t judge anyone without getting to know them first!
translation: 而且我们还没见过她！不了解一个人，就不能随意评判！

source: Either way, we need one more person, so I’ll invite her!
translation: 不管怎样，我们还缺一个人，所以我去邀请她！

source: Hello!
translation: 你好！

source: My name is Yoshinori Nagira!
translation: 我叫Yoshinori Nagira！

source: What’s yours?
translation: 你叫什么名字？

source: Umm, why are you talking to me?
translation: 呃，你为什么和我说话？

source: Well… You were by yourself over here, so I thought you might want to join our group for the activity!
translation: 这个嘛……你一个人待在这里，所以我想你也许愿意加入我们小组参加活动！

source: Do you want to help us set up tents?
translation: 你愿意帮我们搭帐篷吗？

source: Ew, disgusting! I’m not getting my hands dirty on something like that!
translation: 呃，真恶心！我才不会为了那种事弄脏双手！

source: Come on! It’ll be fun! You’ll get in trouble if you just stand there after all!
translation: 来吧！会很有趣的！你一直站在那里，最后会惹麻烦的！

source: Good. I’d rather be expelled from this place then forced to do menial labor.
translation: 很好。我宁愿被这里开除，也不想被迫做低贱的体力劳动。

source: If you really hate it here so much why did you join?
translation: 你真这么讨厌这里，为什么还要参加？

source: It’s none of your business. Just leave me alone.
translation: 不关你的事。别来烦我。

source: Well, I guess you’re gonna have to spend the night out in the cold, then.
translation: 好吧，那看来你今晚只能在寒冷的户外过夜了。

source: Sleeping on the grass, getting wet from the morning dew, and then there’s the bugs…
translation: 睡在草地上，被清晨的露水弄湿，还有那些虫子……

source: Oh, and did I mention there’s always a risk of getting mauled by a bear while you sleep?
translation: 哦，我有没有提过，睡觉时还随时可能被熊撕碎？

source: Wh-What?! Do you mean we’re staying here overnight?!
translation: 什、什么？！你是说我们要在这里过夜？！

source: I mean… We are at “Camp” Buddy… Why else would we be setting up tents and making a campfire?
translation: 我是说……这里可是伙伴“营”……不然我们为什么要搭帐篷、生篝火？

source: I swear this godforsaken camp will be the end of me! I’m surrounded by idiots!
translation: 我发誓，这个鬼地方迟早会害死我！我身边全是白痴！

source: Come on, don’t be so dramatic!
translation: 拜托，别这么夸张！

source: Dramatic?! You have no idea how terrible this is compared to my high-end lifestyle!
translation: 夸张？！和我的高端生活相比，你根本不知道这里有多糟糕！

source: They could’ve sent at least one butler for me to order around!
translation: 他们至少也该派一个管家来听我使唤！

source: Ugh! Why did my parents even send me here?! I can’t believe they spent money just for me to be forced into labor!
translation: 呃！我父母为什么要把我送来这里？！真不敢相信他们花钱就是为了强迫我劳动！

source: It’s not just work! It’s a learning experience, and it’ll be fun!
translation: 这不只是劳动！也是一次学习经历，而且会很有趣！

source: There’s nothing ‘fun’ about setting up tents. And I don’t need to learn how, especially when I have people to do it for me.
translation: 搭帐篷没有任何“乐趣”。我也不需要学，尤其是我有人替我做。

source: Oh, come on, that’s not what the camp spirit is about!
translation: 哦，拜托，营地精神可不是这样！

source: Eugh…
You can roll your eyes all you want, but you’re here at Camp Buddy!
translation: 随便你怎么翻白眼，但你现在就在伙伴营！

source: Don’t you think it would be a lot better if you try and enjoy your time here instead of sulking all day?
translation: 与其整天闷闷不乐，试着享受在这里的时光不是好得多吗？

source: If you keep this up, you’ll be bear food later tonight!
translation: 再这样下去，今晚你就会变成熊的食物！

source: Oh, shut up! Do you really think I’m stupid enough to believe that?
translation: 哦，闭嘴！你真觉得我蠢到会相信吗？

source: Haha, I’m just kidding! You’ve been frowning this whole time – you don’t want wrinkles on your face, do you?
translation: 哈哈，我只是开玩笑！你一直皱着眉头——总不想脸上长皱纹吧？

source: Wh-What…? Wrinkles…?
translation: 什、什么……？皱纹……？

source: Pffft!!
A-Ahehe…
translation: 啊、啊嘿嘿……

source: You’re such a weirdo, what the heck?!
translation: 你真是个怪人，搞什么啊？！

source: I’ve been called that a couple of times, but I try to take it as a compliment.
translation: 别人这么叫过我几次，不过我尽量把它当成夸奖。

source: Are you for real?!
translation: 你是认真的吗？！

source: “The best scout around,” say the scoutmasters! I’m as real as you can get!
translation: 教官们都说我是“这里最棒的童子军”！当然再认真不过！

source: You’re not like the other people around here huh…?
translation: 你和这里其他人不太一样，对吧……？

source: They did say I stand out from the crowd, after all.
translation: 毕竟他们确实说过我在人群中很显眼。

source: *chuckles*
translation: *轻笑*

source: So, you wanna join our tent-building group?
translation: 那么，你愿意加入我们的帐篷搭建小组吗？

source: Fine. I’ll join your group. But you won’t see me doing any of that filthy work.
translation: 好吧。我加入你们。但别指望我会做任何肮脏的工作。

source: Alright! Come with me then!
translation: 好！那就跟我来吧！

source: Here she is! This is… umm… uhh…
translation: 她来了！这位是……嗯……呃……

source: I think you forgot to tell me your name!
translation: 我想你忘记告诉我名字了！

source: I just chose not to tell you, stupid.
translation: 我只是选择不告诉你，笨蛋。

source: It’s Emilia. Emilia Komarova.
translation: 我叫Emilia。Emilia Komarova。

source: Emilia! That’s a nice name!~
translation: Emilia！真是个好听的名字～

source: Well, Emilia, I’d like to introduce you to your new teammates!
translation: 好了，Emilia，我来把你的新队友介绍给你！

source: No need for introductions, I already know about them.
translation: 不必介绍，我已经了解他们了。

source: Pink hair’s the scoutmaster’s daughter, the one not in a uniform is part of the help…
translation: 粉色头发的是教官的女儿，没穿制服的那个是帮工……

source: Oh, and the other two are just regular background characters.
translation: 哦，另外两个只是普通背景角色。

source: B-Background?!
translation: 背、背景角色？！

source: I’ve already reviewed who the people around me are without actually talking to them.
translation: 我不用亲自交谈，就已经调查过身边的人都是谁。

source: I always like to be a step ahead of everybody else.
translation: 我总喜欢领先其他人一步。

source: Well, maybe we could get to know you instead?
translation: 那么，也许我们可以反过来了解你？

source: There’s no need, you’ll know me when you know me.
translation: 没那个必要，该了解我的时候自然会了解。

source: Well, I’m learning about you right now.
translation: 这个嘛，我现在就在了解你。

source: and I oop—
translation: 而我——哎呀——

source: A-Anyway, why don’t we just focus on the task at hand? We have to build these tents!
translation: 总、总之，我们还是专心做眼前的任务吧？得把这些帐篷搭起来！

source: Yeah, I’m still not doing that.
translation: 对，但我还是不会动手。

source: So much for being “a step ahead of everybody else.”
translation: 所谓的“领先其他人一步”也不过如此。

source: Why did you invite her to our group again, Yoshi?
translation: 你为什么又把她邀请进我们组，Yoshi？

source: Yuri, chill!
translation: Yuri，冷静！

source: Excuse me, I wasn’t ‘invited’. I simply had no choice since Yoshinori here wouldn’t take ‘no’ for an answer.
translation: 抱歉，我并不是被“邀请”的。只是这位Yoshinori不接受我的拒绝，让我别无选择。

source: And I don’t lie about things I can’t do. I’m not supposed to know everything, hmph!
translation: 而且我不会谎称自己会做不会的事。我又不需要什么都懂，哼！

source: Well, I’ll help you get started if you don’t know the basics! I promise it’s not that complicated!
translation: 如果你不懂基础，我会帮你入门！我保证没有那么复杂！

source: Fine!
translation: 好吧！

source: But only because you’re doing a better job at giving me the special treatment I deserve than everyone else.
translation: 不过只是因为，比起其他人，你更懂得给我应得的特殊待遇。

source: Ugh… Do we really have to work with her…?
translation: 呃……我们真的非得和她一起工作吗……？

source: Come on, Yuri! Give her a chance!
translation: 拜托，Yuri！给她一个机会！

source: Well, are you going to keep me waiting?
translation: 好了，你打算让我一直等吗？

source: Ah, of course! Let me lead the way!
translation: 啊，当然！让我来带路！

source: *whistles* That’s one spicy girl… And I’m not a fan of spicy.
translation: *吹口哨* 真是个火辣的女孩……可我不喜欢辣。

source: I… can’t believe she called us background characters…
translation: 真……不敢相信她把我们叫作背景角色……

source: You’re a main character to me.
translation: 在我心里，你是主角。

source: Th-That… doesn’t help at all.
translation: 那、那……完全没有安慰到我。

source: This is the reason why I didn’t want her on our team… There’s something really off about her.
translation: 这就是我不想让她入队的原因……她真的很不对劲。

source: But I guess Yoshi sees something in her that we don’t.
translation: 不过我想，Yoshi在她身上看到了我们没看到的东西。

source: Haha, Yoshi does have a good eye for people, so maybe we should just give her a chance!
translation: 哈哈，Yoshi看人确实很准，所以也许我们该给她一个机会！

source: Maybe she’s the kind that mellows out as you hang out with her more.
translation: 也许她是那种相处久了就会变温和的人。

source: *sigh* I hope you guys are right. But she still doesn’t pass my vibe check.
translation: *叹气* 希望你们是对的。不过她还是通不过我的气场检测。

source: It’s a girl’s intuition. You guys wouldn’t understand.
translation: 这是女生的直觉。你们不会懂的。

source: Hehe, can’t argue with that~
translation: 嘿嘿，这话没法反驳～

source: Anyways, let’s help Yoshi out before he gets pushed around all day!
translation: 总之，趁Yoshi还没被使唤一整天，我们去帮帮他吧！

source: Okay, that’s enough chitchat and reunions for today!
translation: 好了，今天的闲聊和重逢到此为止！

source: I came here for work, and there’s a LOT of stuff I need to inspect on my checklist, after all.
translation: 毕竟我是来工作的，清单上还有一大堆东西需要检查。

source: You may all resume your scheduled tasks, as I would rather conduct my evaluation while everyone is at work in their departments.
translation: 你们可以恢复预定工作，我更愿意在每个人都在各自部门工作时进行评估。

source: Ah, yes, of course… Let me give you a tour.
translation: 啊，是的，当然……让我带你参观。

source: That won’t be necessary. Not much has changed here, so I still know my way around.
translation: 没那个必要。这里没有太大变化，我仍然认得路。

source: More importantly, I would prefer to have an uninterrupted, unbiased assessment.
translation: 更重要的是，我希望进行不受干扰、客观公正的评估。

source: As the camp president, you would unintentionally leave out flaws that an inspector should know about. Not that anything’s wrong with that – I’m sure you understand.
translation: 作为营地负责人，您可能会无意间遗漏检查员应该知道的缺陷。这并不是说有什么不对——相信您能理解。

source: Hm… Very well, then.
translation: 嗯……那好吧。

source: But I don’t mind having a different escort, if you truly insist.
translation: 不过如果您真的坚持，我不介意换一位陪同人员。

source: Yoshinori!
translation: Yoshinori！

source: H-Huh?
translation: 咦、咦？

source: You’ll be happy to assist me with my inspection, yes?
translation: 你会很乐意协助我检查，对吧？

source: O-Of course.
translation: 当、当然。

source: Perfect! I’d expect nothing less from you, after all~
translation: 太好了！毕竟我就知道你不会让我失望～

source: Alright, then. Please follow me.
translation: 好。那么请跟我来。

source: Whew, she’s still as feisty as ever!
translation: 呼，她还是和以前一样厉害！

source: I’d say it’s still an improvement compared to how she acted as a scout.
translation: 不过和她当童子军时相比，我觉得已经进步了。

source: *sigh* She’s still the same snooty person if you ask me.
translation: *叹气* 要我说，她还是那个目中无人的家伙。

source: Well, we don’t have a choice. Mr. Clermont handpicked her for the position.
translation: 我们别无选择。她是Clermont先生亲自挑选担任这个职位的。

source: Now, let’s go back to work.
translation: 现在回去工作吧。

source: —The east is the intended site for additional cabins, while the west is meant for the proposed function hall.
translation: ——东侧是新增小屋的预定场地，西侧则计划建造多功能厅。

source: As you can see, the construction department has nearly entirely cleared the site despite some minor delays. I’ve been told by our architect that we can proceed with earthworks very soon.
translation: 如你所见，尽管略有延误，施工部门已经基本清理完场地。建筑师告诉我，很快就能开始土方工程。

source: If you’d like to take a closer look, I can walk you around the site for—
translation: 如果你想仔细查看，我可以带你绕工地走一圈——

source: My, my, Yoshinori. Slow down a little. My heels are killing me.
translation: 哎呀，Yoshinori。走慢一点。高跟鞋快把我的脚折磨死了。

source: O-Oh, I-I apologize…!
translation: 哦、哦，我、我很抱歉……！

source: It’s just the two of us here, why are you in such a hurry? All you’ve talked about is work ever since I got here.
translation: 这里只有我们两个人，你为什么这么着急？从我到这里起，你说的全是工作。

source: I thought that you needed a quick and concise inspection…
translation: 我以为你需要一次快速简洁的检查……

source: Well yes, but what I mean is that you haven't really told me anything about yourself!
translation: 是没错，但我的意思是，你根本没怎么告诉我自己的情况！

source: Wh-What?
translation: 什、什么？

source: It’s been almost what…? A decade? Aren’t you going to let me catch up with what’s been happening in your life?
translation: 已经快有……十年了吧？你不打算让我了解这些年你生活中发生了什么吗？

source: Well… It’s been okay. For the most part.
translation: 这个嘛……大体上还不错。

source: That is the blandest response I’ve ever heard from you! Aren’t you supposed to be the sunshine scout around here?
translation: 这是我从你口中听过最乏味的回答！你不是这里的阳光童子军吗？

source: A-Ah… I just wasn’t expecting a question like that during this inspection…
translation: 啊、啊……我只是没想到检查期间会被问这种问题……

source: Hmph! I’m a little disappointed, I thought you’d be more eager to catch up with an old colleague!
translation: 哼！我有点失望，还以为你会更期待和老同伴叙旧！

source: I’m so sorry about that, Emilia. But don’t get me wrong, I am actually glad to see you again!
translation: 真的很抱歉，Emilia。但别误会，能再次见到你，我确实很高兴！

source: And to answer your question - Not much has changed for me, except that I’m a scoutmaster now!
translation: 回答你的问题——我的生活没太大变化，只是现在成了童子军教官！

source: I’d say that’s the least surprising change. I knew from the moment we met that you’d end up back at this place.
translation: 我觉得这是最不令人意外的变化。从初次见面起，我就知道你最终会回到这里。

source: W-Well, I did have a bit of a rocky start for my first couple of terms, but thankfully, things have turned out fine.
translation: 这、这个，最初几个营期确实有些坎坷，不过幸好最后一切都很顺利。

source: Really? I thought someone like you would’ve pulled off this kind of job without a hitch.
translation: 真的？我还以为像你这样的人能毫无困难地胜任这份工作。

source: Haha, the job’s not all the fun and games I thought when we were young, but I couldn’t be any happier here. This is more than just a job to me, after all.
translation: 哈哈，这份工作不像我们小时候想的那样只有欢乐和游戏，但我在这里无比幸福。毕竟对我来说，这不只是一份工作。

source: I’d beg to differ. You didn’t seem so enthused showing me around. You looked rather stressed, actually.
translation: 我不敢苟同。带我参观时，你看起来并不热情，实际上还相当焦虑。

source: Like waking up last and being so frantic about this inspection.
translation: 比如最后一个起床，还为这次检查慌成那样。

source: Ah… I’m so embarrassed that you noticed…
translation: 啊……你注意到了，真让我难为情……

source: I’ve been trying to be as useful as I can ever since this project started, and sometimes it just gets overwhelming, is all!
translation: 自从项目开始，我一直努力让自己尽可能派上用场，只是有时会觉得不堪重负！

source: My goodness… You? Overwhelmed with work? That doesn’t sound like you at all.
translation: 我的天……你？被工作压垮？这完全不像你。

source: Weren’t you such the go-getter back then? Since that was how you and I ended up as acquaintances!
translation: 你以前不是最积极进取的人吗？我们正是因此才认识的！

source: *scoffs* Unlike the other scouts.
translation: *嗤笑* 和其他童子军可不一样。

source: Anyway, would you mind telling me exactly what you’re having difficulty with about your work?
translation: 总之，能告诉我你在工作中具体遇到了什么困难吗？

source: Is this… part of your review…?
translation: 这是……评估的一部分吗……？

source: What? No! Of course not!
translation: 什么？不！当然不是！

source: Although, now that you’ve said it – you could consider it a check for a healthy working environment.
translation: 不过既然你这么说——也可以把它看作对健康工作环境的检查。

source: It’s not that serious, honestly. I’m probably just adjusting to all the changes around here slower than everyone else.
translation: 老实说，没那么严重。大概只是我比其他人更难适应这里的一切变化。

source: Is that so…?
translation: 是这样吗……？

source: Like I said, please don’t worry about it! In fact, I’ve already brought it up with someone and am trying to work on it!
translation: 就像我说的，请别担心！事实上，我已经和别人谈过，也在努力解决！

source: You have my word that it won’t affect the work we’re doing here!
translation: 我向你保证，这不会影响我们在这里的工作！

source: Fine. I’ll take that with a grain of salt.
translation: 好吧。我会保留看法。

source: Should we continue with our tou—
translation: 我们可以继续参——

source: I have to admit, I was thrilled when I confirmed you were working here at Camp Buddy. It’s just a pleasure to be reunited, don’t you think so?
translation: 我得承认，确认你在伙伴营工作时，我非常高兴。能够重逢实在令人愉快，你不这么认为吗？

source: What’s wrong?
translation: 怎么了？

source: Forgive me for the assumption… But I thought you disliked your time here at the camp, along with everyone in it.
translation: 请原谅我的猜测……但我以为你不喜欢在营地的时光，也不喜欢这里的任何人。

source: In fact, I never heard anything from you after we all finished our first term.
translation: 事实上，第一期结束后，我就再也没有收到过你的消息。

source: That should’ve been obvious, don’t you think? I’m the only heir to my family’s grandiose conglomerate after all, so of course I’d be busy.
translation: 这不是显而易见吗？毕竟我是家族庞大企业集团的唯一继承人，当然会很忙。

source: That’s why I’m really surprised that you’re excited to be back.
translation: 所以你会为回来感到兴奋，真的让我很惊讶。

source: Well, you’re not wrong, I was quite the sniveller during my stay here as a scout. But that’s so long ago.
translation: 你说得没错，我当童子军待在这里时确实是个爱抱怨的人。不过那已经是很久以前了。

source: You made that summer bearable for me to say the least, so that must mean something, yes?
translation: 至少是你让我熬过了那个夏天，所以这总该说明些什么，对吧？

source: Don’t misunderstand. I still have the same sophistication as before~
translation: 别误会。我依旧和从前一样高雅～

source: But I’ll try to be more tolerant this time, especially with you around to make my stay pleasant again.
translation: 不过这次我会尽量更宽容，尤其有你在身边，让我的停留再次变得愉快。

source: I-I’ll do what I can…
translation: 我、我会尽力……

source: Anyway, shall we continue the tour? I noticed you haven’t listed anything from our first department…
translation: 总之，我们继续参观好吗？我注意到你还没记录第一个部门的任何内容……

source: Do you need help or am I distracting you from the inspection?
translation: 你需要帮忙，还是我妨碍你检查了？

source: Talk about rude! I’m just trying to have a conversation with you!
translation: 太无礼了！我只是想和你聊聊天！

source: Goodness gracious, when did you get so impatient?!
translation: 我的天，你什么时候变得这么没耐心了？！

source: N-No, that’s not what I meant—
translation: 不、不是，我不是那个意思——

source: And for your information, I KNOW what I’m doing.
translation: 另外告诉你，我知道自己在做什么。

source: Mr. Clermont hired me as the quality assurance manager here because I have all the right certifications and have far exceeded the qualifications!
translation: Clermont先生聘请我担任这里的质量保证经理，是因为我拥有所有相关证书，而且资历远超要求！

source: I… didn’t mean it like that, Emilia…
translation: 我……不是那个意思，Emilia……

source: If you’re going to act like this, let’s get this tour over with!
translation: 既然你要这种态度，那就赶紧结束参观吧！

source: Come on, this checklist won’t check itself!
translation: 快点，这张清单可不会自己检查！

source: {i}(I must’ve upset Emilia by bringing up work too much during our talk…){/i}
translation: {i}（我在谈话中提了太多工作，一定惹Emilia生气了……）{/i}

source: {i}(For the rest of the day, she was much stricter and snippier about each department we inspected, asking a lot of questions, and going into every detail…){/i}
translation: {i}（当天剩下的时间里，她对我们检查的每个部门都更加严格、说话也更尖锐，问了许多问题，深究每个细节……）{/i}

source: {i}(Eventually, we had finished everything she wanted to see, and the scoutmasters gathered in the office for her report.){/i}
translation: {i}（最后，我们看完了她想检查的一切，教官们也聚集到办公室听取报告。）{/i}

source: I’ll get straight to the point.
translation: 我就开门见山了。

source: Based on how the inspection went today, EVERYTHING is off from their initial targets.
translation: 根据今天的检查结果，所有项目都偏离了最初目标。

source: I will be giving general feedback on each department I had an issue with.
translation: 我会针对发现问题的每个部门给出总体反馈。

source: Note that this report will be sent to Mr. Clermont, but I will enumerate all my concerns just so everyone knows where they missed the mark.
translation: 请注意，这份报告会发送给Clermont先生，不过我会逐一列出所有担忧，让每个人知道自己哪里没有达标。

source: Sheesh, Yoshi… What the heck made her so mad during the inspection?
translation: 天啊，Yoshi……检查期间到底发生了什么，让她这么生气？

source: Well… I don’t think it has to do with the inspection, to be honest…
translation: 这个嘛……老实说，我觉得和检查本身无关……

source: I hope we’re not in trouble, then…
translation: 那希望我们不会有麻烦……

source: Um, excuse me? I need everyone’s full attention. This is very important.
translation: 嗯，打扰一下？我需要所有人集中注意力。这非常重要。

source: Ah, sorry about that!
translation: 啊，抱歉！

source: So, I’ve divided my concerns into four categories – construction, staff, technology, and management.
translation: 我把问题分成四类——施工、员工、技术和管理。

source: Let’s start with construction, shall we?
translation: 先从施工开始，好吗？

source: According to the schedule, the site should’ve been cleared yesterday. Yet, I saw it was still in progress, and took up this whole workday to finish.
translation: 按照日程，场地昨天就该清理完毕。但我看到工作仍在进行，而且花了今天整整一个工作日才完成。

source: Ah, yes. It’s a good thing our staff was able to help the construction team. Or else we would’ve been delayed further.
translation: 啊，是的。幸好我们的员工能协助施工团队，否则进度会进一步延误。

source: That’s not a good thing at all. I’m concerned that we’re experiencing delays already and the project has barely started.
translation: 这完全不是好事。项目才刚开始就已经出现延误，这令我担忧。

source: Not to mention over a task as minor as site clearing.
translation: 更不用说，导致延误的还只是场地清理这样的小任务。

source: It’s not a big setback at all, is it? Everyone really worked hard to make up for it too.
translation: 这不算严重的挫折吧？而且大家也很努力地弥补了。

source: That brings me to another point: why were non-construction staff involved in the first place?
translation: 这就引出了另一个问题：为什么非施工人员一开始会参与进来？

source: If they had been supervising as per the plan, these issues might not have happened.
translation: 如果他们按计划进行监督，这些问题也许根本不会发生。

source: Ah, we apologize for stepping out of scope. There were some unforeseen difficulties that required more manpower to complete the site clearing in time.
translation: 啊，我们为超出职责范围道歉。当时出现了一些意外困难，需要更多人手才能及时完成场地清理。

source: Everyone did what they thought was best in the moment, but that doesn’t change the outcome.
translation: 每个人当时都做了自己认为最好的选择，但这并不能改变结果。

source: Even if we disregarded today’s delay, there is still debris on the site.
translation: 即使不考虑今天的延误，场地上仍然留有废料。

source: That doesn’t look like a cleared site now, does it?
translation: 那可不像已经清理完毕的场地，对吧？

source: That isn't debris. We plan to recycle it as firewood for the incoming winter.
translation: 那不是废料。我们计划把它们回收成即将到来的冬季所需的柴火。

source: That’s not an excuse to just leave it on the site. This camp has a storage shed to keep all clutter, am I not correct?
translation: 这不能成为把它们留在场地上的借口。营地有储物棚来存放所有杂物，我没说错吧？

source: We’ll make sure to work on that right away.
translation: 我们会确保立刻处理。

source: Moving on, let’s discuss staff welfare. There’s a very peculiar rumor going around amongst the workers during my survey.
translation: 继续下一个问题，我们来谈谈员工福祉。调查期间，我听到工人之间流传着一则非常奇怪的传闻。

source: I overheard that one of the management staff was being too “friendly” with the construction crew, which was causing a lot of distractions.
translation: 我听说有一名管理人员对施工队过于“友好”，造成了许多干扰。

source: One even mentioned… a “beefcake show”???
translation: 甚至有人提到……“肌肉猛男秀”？？？

source: I am not sure what that means, but this concerns you, Mr. Flynn.
translation: 我不确定那是什么意思，不过这件事和您有关，Flynn先生。

source: W-Well, I didn’t mean to cause any trouble… I was just trying to make the workers happy.
translation: 这、这个，我不是故意制造麻烦……只是想让工人们开心。

source: Your job isn’t to entertain them. You’re supposed to take care of their essential needs, nothing more.
translation: 你的职责不是娱乐他们。你只应该照顾他们的基本需求，仅此而已。

source: Eh… I’m doing that already. I’m sure a little chit-chat here and there won’t hurt anybody, haha!
translation: 呃……我已经在做了。偶尔聊几句肯定不会伤害任何人，哈哈！

source: Take this job seriously! You’re a scoutmaster, aren’t you?
translation: 认真对待这份工作！你是童子军教官，不是吗？

source: A-Ahh… Right, sorry.
translation: 啊、啊……好吧，抱歉。

source: Next topic, technology. I consulted with Mr. Choi a while ago, and he explained all his tasks so far.
translation: 下一个主题是技术。我不久前咨询了Choi先生，他解释了迄今为止的所有任务。

source: Looking at the original scope of the project, I’ve noticed that some of the offered technology integration was declined?
translation: 查看项目的原始范围后，我注意到有人拒绝了部分技术整合方案？

source: Ah, I’m responsible for that.
translation: 啊，那是我的决定。

source: There’s a good reason why I removed some of the proposed integrations.
translation: 我删去部分拟议整合项目是有充分理由的。

source: I wanted technological implementation kept to an essential minimum so that we can maintain the true essence of the camp.
translation: 我希望把技术应用限制在必要的最低程度，以维持营地真正的本质。

source: Don’t take this the wrong way, but a decision like that is nothing more than a missed opportunity.
translation: 别误会，但这样的决定不过是在错失机会。

source: Everything is already served on a silver platter. It’s all PAID, and you just have to say yes.
translation: 一切都已经送到你们面前，费用全部付清，你们只要点头同意。

source: These changes are inevitable anyways, so there’s no reason to hold back now.
translation: 无论如何，这些变化都不可避免，所以现在没有理由畏缩。

source: Now, what’s causing all these issues? Everything boils down to the management department.
translation: 那么，所有这些问题的根源是什么？最终都归结到管理部门。

source: This establishment is SEVERELY understaffed to begin with, and to be honest, most of your roles are scattered and hard to pin down.
translation: 首先，这个机构人手严重不足。老实说，你们大多数人的职责分散，很难明确界定。

source: For example, Ms. Nomoru isn’t well-versed enough to be supervising the entire construction department.
translation: 例如，Nomoru女士还不够精通相关事务，无法监督整个施工部门。

source: Is Mr. Flynn really a scoutmaster, or still a helper? He contrastingly handles maintenance and culinary tasks, which are supposed to be done by two different people.
translation: Flynn先生究竟是童子军教官，还是仍然只是帮工？他同时负责维护和餐饮工作，而这本应由两个不同的人承担。

source: And most importantly, it has come to my attention that Yoshinori has no permanent role around the camp!
translation: 最重要的是，我注意到Yoshinori在营地里根本没有固定职务！

source: I personally know that he is skillful in management; but I assume it’s hard for him to step up if the figure of authority is not allowing him to use his full potential.
translation: 我亲自了解他的管理能力，但如果权威人物不允许他发挥全部潜力，他恐怕很难挺身而出。

source: That sums up all of my concerns. I hope everyone paid attention.
translation: 以上就是我的所有担忧。希望大家都认真听了。

source: We understand, and I take responsibility as the camp president.
translation: 我们明白，作为营地负责人，我会承担责任。

source: It’s my duty to prevent these issues and direct everyone to achieve our mutual goals.
translation: 预防这些问题，并带领大家实现共同目标，是我的职责。

source: Dad…
translation: 爸爸……

source: I will do my best to make everything right from hereon.
translation: 从现在起，我会尽力纠正一切。

source: Very well. Mr. Clermont chose me to guarantee that this sponsorship meets his expectations.
translation: 很好。Clermont先生选择我，是为了确保这项赞助符合他的期望。

source: With that in mind and considering your staffing issue, I will personally stay here for the span of this project.
translation: 鉴于这一点，以及你们的人手问题，我会在整个项目期间亲自留在这里。

source: This will ensure a stricter schedule and allow me to serve as a bridge of communication between Camp Buddy and Clermont Inc.
translation: 这能确保日程得到更严格的执行，也让我能够充当伙伴营与Clermont公司之间的沟通桥梁。

source: Is that really necessary? We regularly receive our tasks from Mr. Clermont himself. And as far as I know we haven’t had any problems when it comes to communication.
translation: 真的有必要吗？我们会定期直接收到Clermont先生布置的任务。据我所知，沟通方面一直没有问题。

source: Mr. Clermont is a very busy man, and it’s unreasonable to expect to maintain direct communication with him throughout the entire project.
translation: Clermont先生非常忙碌，指望在整个项目期间始终与他直接沟通并不合理。

source: He doesn’t have time to handle every issue that arises. So, that’s where I come in.
translation: 他没有时间处理出现的每个问题。所以这就是我发挥作用的地方。

source: My job is to prevent problems. I can already see cracks forming in the work done so far, and I need to resolve them as early as possible.
translation: 我的职责是预防问题。我已经看到目前的工作开始出现裂痕，必须尽早解决。

source: Do you want to wait until a serious concern arises? Do you want to break Mr. Clermont’s trust on this project? I assume the answer to both is no.
translation: 你们想等到严重问题出现吗？想辜负Clermont先生对这个项目的信任吗？我想两个问题的答案都是否定的。

source: Don’t take any of this personally, it’s just my job after all.
translation: 别把这些话当成针对个人，毕竟这只是我的工作。

source: Don’t take any of this personally, it’s just my job after all.{fast}
translation: 别把这些话当成针对个人，毕竟这只是我的工作。{fast}

source: We'll do better next time.
translation: 我们下次会做得更好。

source: We’ll do better next time.
translation: 我们下次会做得更好。

source: As you should.
translation: 本就应该如此。

source: We understand your concerns.
translation: 我们理解你的担忧。

source: We'll try to meet your expectations.
translation: 我们会努力达到你的期望。

source: We’ll try our best to meet your expectations.
translation: 我们会尽最大努力达到你的期望。

source: See? Yoshinori understands!
translation: 看到了吗？Yoshinori明白！

source: Whatever's best for the camp.
translation: 一切以营地的利益为重。

source: We’ll do whatever’s best for the camp.
translation: 我们会做一切对营地最有利的事。

source: Oh! And one more thing.
translation: 哦！还有一件事。

source: All the cabins seem to be fully occupied, and it would be inappropriate for me to share a room with the workers.
translation: 所有小屋似乎都住满了，而让我和工人共住一个房间也不合适。

source: I’ll be needing a room of my own to stay in.
translation: 我需要一间自己的房间。

source: Well, too bad. We don’t have any—
translation: 真遗憾。我们没有任何——

source: You can stay in my quarters here in the office, Ms. Komarova.
translation: Komarova女士，你可以住在我办公室里的房间。

source: It’s clean and well-maintained, as well as the biggest room in the camp. It should meet all of your requirements.
translation: 那里干净、维护良好，也是营地最大的房间，应该能满足你的所有要求。

source: I’ll just move into the staff quarters. There should be an extra bed there, anyway.
translation: 我搬去员工宿舍就好。反正那里应该还有一张空床。

source: That’s perfect! I’ll take it.
translation: 太好了！我就住那里。

source: Aiden, why don’t you move Ms. Komarova’s stuff? Yuri, you can help me pack my things as well.
translation: Aiden，你去搬Komarova女士的行李吧。Yuri，你也可以帮我收拾东西。

source: I’m sorry for asking but… did you really think everything was that bad so far?
translation: 抱歉这么问，不过……你真的觉得目前的一切有那么糟糕吗？

source: Well, it’s my job to point out concerns, and I only commented on what I found on my inspection.
translation: 指出问题是我的职责，我只是评论了检查中发现的情况。
